### Removed
- **The classic KServe `InferenceService` serving path — llm-d is the one serving path.** Breaking (giantswarm/agent-platform#574; the platform's decision that no model is served on the classic vLLM path any more, no fallback, no deprecation window). The connectivity chart rendered two paths for a served model: the classic `InferenceService` on the chart's `kserve-vllm` `ClusterServingRuntime` (`modelServing.runtime`, `modelServing.additionalRuntimes`, the classic predictor pod shape in the Kyverno policies, the network policies and the `PolicyException`, the `serving.kserve.io/v1beta1` check behind `kserve.requireApi`, the `runtime` / `runtimes` keys of the discovery ConfigMap) and the llm-d path (`LLMInferenceService` on the well-known `LLMInferenceServiceConfig`s, the models Gateway), while every shipped preset was composed onto the llm-d template by model-manager. Now the chart renders no `serving.kserve.io` object at all: model-manager composes a published preset into an `LLMInferenceService`, and the serving namespace's policies, network policies and exception select that workload pod alone (`kserve.io/component=workload`, `app.kubernetes.io/part-of=llminferenceservice`, container `main`, port 8000). Removed, and **refused by the render naming the key**: `templates/model-serving/clusterservingruntime.yaml`; the values `modelServing.runtime`, `modelServing.additionalRuntimes` (4.36.0, #550), `modelServing.networkPolicy.predictor` (its `additionalIngressNamespaces` is `modelServing.networkPolicy.additionalIngressNamespaces`), `modelServing.serving.deploymentStrategyType` and `.timeoutSeconds`; the preset fields `spec.runtime` and `spec.predictor` (the shipped `qwen3-8-27b`, `qwen3-8-27b-l40s` and `qwen3-8-flash-next-nvfp4` lose their `predictor.timeout`, the Flash-Next preset its `runtime: kserve-vllm-b12x` — its B12X serving image is the well-known config's to name); the discovery ConfigMap's `spec.runtime` and `spec.runtimes`. `modelServing.kserve.requireApi` and `modelManager.kserve.requireApi` check `serving.kserve.io/v1alpha2` (`LLMInferenceService`) and are satisfied by the `kserve-llmisvc-crd` + `kserve-llmisvc-resources` components. The meta chart drops the classic controller's components `kserve-crd` and `kserve-resources` and their values blocks (refused too): `kserve-llmisvc-crd` ships every CRD the llm-d path needs (`llminferenceservices`, `llminferenceserviceconfigs`, `clusterstoragecontainers`), and the `kserve-llmisvc-resources` release renders the control plane's shared objects itself (`kserve.createSharedResources: true`, the chart's default; a `false` is refused) with `controller.deploymentMode: Standard` and `gateway.disableIngressCreation: true`, receives the derived models-Gateway reference (`controller.gateway.ingressGateway.kserveGateway`) and depends on `kserve-llmisvc-crd` alone; the connectivity release depends on no kserve component (it renders no `serving.kserve.io` CR), `model-manager` depends on `kserve-llmisvc-resources` and its range is `>=0.23.0 <2.0.0` (model-manager 1.0.0 composes `LLMInferenceService`s only; nothing the chart forwards names the values it drops). `examples/serving-slice.yaml`, `ci/test-slice-serving-values.yaml`, the CI fixtures and the BOM switch the llm-d components on alone; `tests/verify-runtimes.py`, its fixture and the classic predictor pod fixture are gone, and `verify-wiring` asserts that the classic keys and components fail the render naming them and that the serving render carries no `serving.kserve.io` object. UPGRADE.md, "the classic KServe `InferenceService` path is removed". Closes giantswarm/agent-platform#561 (removed with the feature).
